units.name: Department of Systems Management Engineering
units.evidence: Official department introduction explicitly names Department of Systems Management Engineering, OR/production/quality/ergonomics research and Industrial Engineering PhD. Department renamed from Industrial Engineering in 1999, while graduate degree title remains Industrial Engineering; no duplicate department created.

units.name: SKK Business School
units.evidence: Actual SKK Business School graduate MS/PhD introduction explicitly includes Production Management as formal doctoral major field and research/thesis objectives; substantive Ops doctoral remit, not a single generic required course.

decisions.reason: Original record is bare university placeholder, not a department. Actual relevant Systems Management Engineering department and Business School verified independently.

sources.note: Entire official College of Engineering Systems Management Engineering introduction read: actual department, research in OR/production/quality/ergonomics, exact Doctor of Philosophy in Industrial Engineering, 48 coursework credits beyond bachelor’s and 24-credit dissertation. Same page explicitly distinguishes current department name and degree title, historical doctoral establishment in 1986 and first three PhD graduates in 1993; legacy resource/faculty details not assumed current census.

Entire current SKK Business School Graduate MS/PhD introduction read. Explicit doctoral major fields including Production Management alongside marketing/organization/HR/MIS/accounting/finance; separate PhD learning objectives include academic research and thesis/dissertation integrity. This is formal doctoral field, not one general core course.

Entire current general Graduate Programs university inventory read, Humanities/Social and Natural Science campuses. Business Administration major and doctoral Production Management field confirmed; Industrial Engineering current engineering major. Wider engineering programmes include Smart Factory Convergence, Service Design, crisis/disaster/risk, technology programmes requiring separate degree/field mapping; not fabricated independent departments.

limitations: Systems Management Engineering department name differs from actual Industrial Engineering graduate award; same official page expressly maps them.
Department page includes legacy faculty/resource and history details; these are not a completed current faculty census.
Current graduate programme names such as Smart Factory Convergence are programmes, not automatically new administrative departments. Detailed wider doctoral fields remain incomplete separately.
